segments.text: How can two degrees change the weather in India and the USA?
The middle of the Pacific is more than two degrees Celsius warmer than usual. When it gets that warm, scientists call it a Super El Niño.
Across a whole ocean, that is a huge amount of heat.
El Niño moves rain around the world. In India, this year's monsoon brought about one-eighth less rain than normal, the weakest in over ten years. The south and the northeast were driest.
In the USA, it works the other way for some places. This winter, scientists expect wetter weather than usual across the south, like California and Florida, and a warmer winter up north.
